transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

Lately I feel this heavy, empty mood all the time, like I’m weighed down and can’t shake it no matter what I do. It just feels like I'm constantly dragging myself through the day and nothing seems to help.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in most activities you used to enjoy, even things that used to make you happy?

Yeah, I've completely lost interest in everything I used to love. I used to live for painting murals and playing weekend soccer, but now I can't feel any excitement or care about it anymore. Even when my friends bring by sketches or invite me out, I just stare at them and say no.
How long has this low mood lasted, and have you had similar episodes in the past?

This heavy, empty mood has been with me almost every day for a little over a year now, starting not long after I picked up those extra night shifts. I've never felt anything like this in the past; this is the first time I've ever gone through something like this.
Have you had any periods lasting several weeks or more during this past year where you felt clearly better, almost back to your usual self, even if just for a short time?

No, I haven't really had any periods where I felt back to my usual self. That heavy, numb depression has been constant and hasn't let up since I started those extra shifts over a year ago. Even during times when the ideas about being watched backed off a bit, the dark mood was still right there.

The current presentation is more consistent with a single, prolonged major depressive episode, supporting F32 (depressive episode). No evidence of manic, hypomanic, or psychotic symptoms was mentioned, so other categories remain less likely. However, the persistence of symptoms for over a year raises consideration of chronicity, though without mood variation suggesting dysthymia (F34.1), and given the severity described, F32 remains the best fit for now.
